<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me check current cursor position and try to navigate between strips
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

# Find cursor position
cursor_pos = []
for r in range(38, 60):
    for c in range(64):
        if ascii_lines[r][c] in 'wW':
            cursor_pos.append((r, c))

print(f"Cursor pixels: {cursor_pos[:10]}...")
print(f"Cursor row range: {min(r for r,c in cursor_pos)}-{max(r for r,c in cursor_pos)}")
print(f"Cursor col range: {min(c for r,c in cursor_pos)}-{max(c for r,c in cursor_pos)}")

# Try pressing UP to see if cursor moves between strips
action(['UP'])
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

new_cursor = []
for r in range(38, 60):
    for c in range(64):
        if ascii_lines[r][c] in 'wW':
            new_cursor.append((r, c))

print(f"After UP - Cursor row range: {min(r for r,c in new_cursor)}-{max(r for r,c in new_cursor)}")
print(f"After UP - Cursor col range: {min(c for r,c in new_cursor)}-{max(c for r,c in new_cursor)}")

# Check if we're now on sky blue strip
if min(r for r,c in new_cursor) < 47:
    print("Cursor moved to sky blue strip!")
